common.tagline: Instruments handcrafted, one at a time.

footer.craft: Artisanal luthiery — every instrument is one of a kind.

home.heroTitle: The instrument of your dreams, built by hand
home.heroSubtitle: Every Bocatto guitar is born from hand-picked tonewoods, decades of craft and your choices — from the top to the last fret.
home.pillar1Body: Tops, backs and sides chosen piece by piece, naturally seasoned for years, for a voice that matures with you.
home.pillar2Body: No assembly line. Every joint, purfling and finish is executed by hand, one instrument at a time.
home.pillar3Body: An instrument designed around your touch: tension, scale and voicing tailored to the way you play.
home.priceBody: Each project is quoted individually, according to the woods and details you choose.
home.ctaBody: Design your ideal guitar in our configurator. At the end you receive a document with all your choices — no commitment.

about.title: About Bocatto
about.historyTitle: A life devoted to wood and sound
about.historyBody1: Bocatto Luthieria was born from a passion for turning wood into music. In our workshop every instrument is built from scratch, by hand, following traditional luthiery techniques refined over years of craft.
about.historyBody2: We don't do serial production. Each guitar is a unique project, designed in conversation with the person who will play it — from the soundboard woods to the rosette design.
about.philosophyBody: We believe a great instrument is born from the balance between tradition and personality. That's why we listen before we build: your repertoire, your touch and your references guide every design decision.
about.catalogTitle: A few examples from the workshop
about.catalogIntro: A small sample of projects that have left our bench. Yours could be next.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about a project, timelines or woods? Write to us — we reply personally.
contact.success: Message sent! We'll get back to you soon.
contact.error: We couldn't send it right now. Try again or reach us on WhatsApp.
contact.whatsappBody: Message us on WhatsApp and talk directly to the luthier.

config.title: Build your guitar
config.welcomeBody: In a few steps you choose woods, shape, finish and details. At the end we generate an elegant document with everything you selected and send it to the luthier — no commitment.
config.welcomeNote: The final price is defined by the luthier for each project. Instruments starting at R$ 9,000 (BRL).
